description: This file contains platform-dependent and utility functions for Http Mbo Chunked Object, including the creation function 'HttpCreateMboChunked'. It primarily sets up the interface for creating instances of the chunked object within an HTTP component.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpCreateMboChunked(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: A factory function to create a new Http Mbo Chunked object, accepting three context handles and delegating the creation to 'HttpMboChkCreate'.
